text:
maria (PM): quick thought — we should surface a per-route -> per-model breakdown in Console analytics. teams want to see which model each route is hitting and basic metrics (p50/p95, tokens, error rate) in one place.

josh (Frontend): yes. UI idea: main route row, expandable 'models' list with tiny sparkline + p95 badge. quick compare checkbox to show two models side-by-side.

kevin (Platform): API question though — do we fetch a single combined payload (route -> model -> metrics) or do multiple calls (route meta + separate model metrics)? combined is fewer rtts but could be huge for high-card routes.

maria (PM): leaning combined for common cases, paginated detail for large results. should be able to switch grouping by "model" or "route" in the console.\njosh (Frontend): perf-wise we can lazy-load the model rows on expand. initial table can show top-1 model by QPS + a caret to fetch the rest. that minimises payload.

kevin (Platform): agree lazy-load. also suggest an API param: `group_by=model` + `limit=10` + `include_sample_rate=true`. example: 
```
GET /api/console/telemetry?route_id=abc123&group_by=model&since=24h&limit=10
```
returns list of {model, qps, p50, p95, sample_rate}.
```

sasha (DataScience): important: we must surface the telemetry sample rate and normalization. if sample_rate < 1 we should show error bars or a small badge "low-sample". people misinterpret p95 without that context.

josh (Frontend): +1 on sample badge. also UX question for saved queries/presets: should per-route presets include the grouping choice (model vs route) and sample filters? users expect "my saved view" to bring back exact panes.

maria (PM): yes saved queries must capture grouping, time range, model filters, and any quota overlays (like show only routes near quota). must be shareable across org.

kevin (Platform): storing server-side is best for shareability, but i want a cheap "quick preset" local option for folks who just toggle often. proposal: local quick-presets (localStorage) + server-saves with ownership/visibility and audit. API: `POST /api/console/saved_queries` with scope=workspace|user.

josh (Frontend): dev note: if saved query includes `include_sample_rate=true`, frontend should surface a tooltip explaining sample-rate implications.

sasha (DataScience): and unit tests / evals: saved queries should link to the promptset/eval used to monitor quality regressions per-route. not required for MVP but add as ticket.

deploy-bot: telemetry-api v3 deployed to staging at 2024-12-03T15:12:03Z — endpoint `GET /api/console/telemetry` now supports `group_by=model`. :rocket:

maria (PM): sweet — action items: @kevin can you draft the API schema for telemetry combined endpoint and saved_queries scope? @josh can you mock the expand-collapse UX and the sample-rate badge? @sasha can you write a short doc on how sample_rate impacts metrics? we'll sync Fri 10am.

kevin (Platform): will do, will drop a proto schema in #eng-platform by EOD.

josh (Frontend): I'll prototype the row expand and share a gif.

sasha (DataScience): i'll sketch the sample badge states and examples.

maria (PM): thanks all. keeping this lightweight — focus on lazy-load + server-saves + sample-rate visibility for MVP.
